items.title: Joe LaBarbera interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 15, 2021
items.q: It could be Tony Williams. But overall in terms of shaping the sound and the feel of the drums and setting the course for the next generation and beyond, Elvin Jones’s impact is monumental.

ctx.x: Fantastic. Last question. If you had a convention of drummers sitting around having a few drinks who do they talk about as the drummer of most distinction?

Wow. You know I’m going to take a stab here and say most distinction probably, and it’s my generation, they’re probably going to say Elvin Jones. Probably going to say Elvin. I © Fillius Jazz Archive -19-

mean it could be Buddy Rich, who I admired greatly. It could be Tony Williams. But overall in terms of shaping the sound and the feel of the drums and setting the course for the next generation and beyond, Elvin Jones’s impact is monumental. I would venture a guess that it would be Elvin.
